task.title: move_selection has the same split-transaction plan/write as pre-P6-120 pull
task.description: Filed from P6-120 (2026-08-10). The selection tray's batch move (move_selection server fn, lib.rs ~1200) composes holdings_of_oracle reads and the move write across separate transactions — the identical check-then-act shape P6-120 just closed for the pull walk (write can act on state the plan never saw; same-device reachable when two tray operations overlap). Fix the same way: a pure planner + one CollectionStore method doing read→plan→write in one scoped_tx with canonically-ordered FOR UPDATE locks, wire byte-compatible. P6-120's pull_plan.rs is the direct template, and it already reuses the shared allocation helpers from app::my. Specs: specs/collection-api.md (P6-120 Findings entry).
